scenes.headline: 24 CLEAN SHEETS / 34 MATCHES
scenes.narration: They kept an incredible 24 clean sheets.

scenes.headline: 13 OF 24 ENDED 0–0
scenes.narration: But here’s the surprising part. 13 of those clean sheets ended in goalless draws.

scenes.headline: NEITHER TEAM SCORED
scenes.narration: Thirteen matches where their opponents couldn’t score... but neither could Hearts.

scenes.headline: DEFENCE ≠ ATTACK
scenes.narration: And that’s the problem. Football isn’t just about stopping goals. You also have to score them.

scenes.headline: 25 GOALS / 34 GAMES
scenes.narration: Hearts managed only 25 goals in 34 matches.

scenes.narration: In fact, they failed to score in 18 matches.

scenes.headline: BOTH LOST 6
scenes.narration: Now, compare that with the eventual champions, Medeama. Both clubs lost exactly six matches.

scenes.headline: MEDEAMA 17 | HEARTS 13
scenes.narration: But while Medeama won 17 games, Hearts managed just 13.

scenes.headline: 54 vs 62 → 8-POINT GAP
scenes.narration: And that difference in wins and draws left Hearts eight points behind the champions.

scenes.headline: DEFENCE ALONE WASN’T ENOUGH
scenes.narration: Hearts had an extraordinary defence. But they couldn’t turn enough of those clean sheets into victories.
